subject: trying to keep just a subset of the samples for further analysis in rstan

messages.author: 69d2dd577dec7f63
messages.subject: trying to keep just a subset of the samples for further analysis in rstan
parts:
Dear mailing list,

I am using rstan and  trying to keep just a subset of my samples and call to stan in rstan is given as:

fit <- stan(model_code = NB_model, data = y1000x30_1_data, 
            iter = 1000, chains = 1, 
            pars=c("phi", "a"), thin=20, sample_file="stan_sample.csv")

However, stan_sample.csv contains all my parameters and transformed parameters and I cannot afford to keep these for memory reasons.

Is my pars option incorrectly specified?

Regards, and thanks,
Margaret Donald

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] trying to keep just a subset of the samples for further analysis in rstan
parts:
"pars" is for specifying samples that would be included in the returned object.  The file always has everything and it should not increase memory usage. 

--
Jiqiang
